judgment.notes: Compared the complete P signature in type-Check.lean with spec H001–H006 and the contract binders. n,m:ℕ with 1≤n∧1≤m retain both positive integer dimensions; u has real Euclidean spatial and target coordinates, and q is one fixed unit vector. H002 demands joint smoothness only on 0<t. H004 and H005 have the original spatial and positive-time quantifiers; H005 is pointwise ∃a:ℝ for utt−Σj uxxj=a•u, without a selected smooth scalar or the derived explicit PDE as input. H006 quantifies each real 0<s<t, chooses one compact C for the entire closed interval, and asserts equality with that same q outside C. H003 is retained in P although unused locally. The final domain is nonvacuous: for positive dimensions a constant unit map satisfies all hypotheses. Through implementation helpers the direct frontiers are R001: H002,H004,H005; R002: H001,H002,H006; R003: H002,N002; R004: H001,H002,N002; R005: H002,N001,N002,N003,N004, with Mathlib freely available. There are no additional external assumptions, object fields, scalar-field changes or hidden target-bearing construction fields.

Independently verified the P correspondence explanation against the definitions and pinned library. PiL2.lean defines EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) as PiLp 2 and its inner product as the finite coordinate sum; PiLp.single 2 j 1 has value 1 at j and 0 elsewhere. Thus Fin n bijectively labels 1,…,n, spatial is the actual coordinate differential, laplace is the componentwise coordinate sum, and density is the Frobenius sum of squared coordinate derivatives with no factor 1/2. The ContDiff scope defines ∞ in ℕ∞ω as the embedded ℕ∞ top, below ω; it means all finite smoothness orders, not analyticity. Restriction of the total u gives a source map, and arbitrary extension of any source map to t≤0 gives the converse: the positive-time domain is open, so all derivatives and energy germs used here are local to the restriction. No smooth extension across zero is required. The pinned Euclidean volume transport identifies volume with product coordinate Lebesgue measure, including Dirac mass one in dimension zero. T003 retains positive box radius, ofReal((2R)^n), and finite mass. Integrable means AEStronglyMeasurable plus HasFiniteIntegral; its explicit assertion prevents the total integral from weakening the endpoint. Positive-order iteratedFDeriv encodes all coordinate mixed derivatives in both directions by evaluation and multilinearity under smoothness. T004 explicitly assigns mixed-derivative identification and derivative existence; T008 assigns the actual representation/measure conversion before FTC/Fubini. HasDerivAt energy 0 is equivalent to differentiability and derivative zero on this open time interval, in both directions.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
